snippet.title: GladiEATers Early Access Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
The GladiEATers demo is still available for those of you looking to whet your appetite! https://store.steampowered.com/app/2141280/GladiEATers/

GladiEATers' Early Access journey comes out Friday May 1st 7pm BST. The delectable first course that you have smelt cooking away for over 4 years is finally approaching. You can see the waiter coming up to your table, stack of plates in hand... this is your food, and you can finally EAT.
